# Unacademy

> India's largest online learning platform offering live classes, test series, and personalized coaching for competitive exams including IIT JEE, NEET, UPSC, and SSC.

Unacademy provides comprehensive exam preparation solutions through live interactive classes, mock tests, and study materials for India's most competitive entrance and recruitment examinations. The platform combines expert educators with technology-driven learning tools to help students achieve their academic and career goals.

## Key Topics

- IIT JEE Main and Advanced
- NEET UG
- UPSC Civil Services Examination
- SSC Exams
- CSIR UGC NET
- Live Classes
- Online Coaching
- Test Series
- Competitive Exams
- Mock Tests
- Exam Preparation

- India Education
- Unacademy Credits
- Rank Predictor

## Exam Preparation Programs

- [IIT JEE Main and Advanced Preparation](https://unacademy.com/goal/jee-main-and-advanced-preparation/TMUVD): IIT JEE exam preparation with live classes and study materials
- [NEET UG 2026 Coaching](https://unacademy.com/goal/neet-ug/YOTUH): NEET UG medical entrance exam preparation with live coaching
- [UPSC Civil Services Examination Preparation](https://unacademy.com/goal/upsc-civil-services-examination-ias-preparation/KSCGY): UPSC Civil Services exam coaching with GS classes and mock tests
- [SSC Exams Preparation](https://unacademy.com/goal/ssc-exams-non-technical/VLEMN): SSC government recruitment exam preparation and study resources
- [CSIR UGC NET 2026 Coaching](https://unacademy.com/goal/csir-ugc-net/BIZXQ): CSIR UGC NET exam coaching with live classes and mock tests
